description: Connect your Apple Music library to %@.
verify_description: Enter the six-digit code sent by Apple to your trusted device.
success_description: You can return to %@ and start listening.
code_hint: Keep this window open until verification is complete.
error_network: The connection could not be completed. Check your network and try again.
error_account: This account is currently unavailable. Check your Apple Account status.
error_terms: Open the official Apple Music app to review your account terms, then try again.
error_rejected: The connection was not completed. Check your account details and verification code.
error_unavailable: The connection could not be completed. Please try again later.
